units.source_text: 分明看见的是玻璃屋顶，却极力装出看见天空的样子。

en.t: What I can clearly see is a glass roof, yet I try my hardest to pretend that I am looking at the sky.

units.source_text: 因为三面镜宛如合页门，你可以信手把映照出令人讨厌的东西的那扇门关掉，用不着顾忌我。”

en.t: Since the three mirrors are like folding doors, you can casually close the one that reflects unpleasant things, without worrying about me.
